notes: §2002:13.16.41.3 GR3 sizes a record by the maximum of its variable-length data item: FR = 2 + 10 = 12 bytes, so at --std 2002 RECORD CONTAINS 12 runs (g2-record-contains-odo-maximum, F=00) and 11 is refused COBOL2010 '3 to 12 bytes'; pb1277_record_size_in_bytes covers bytes regardless of character type at 2002. kb/Work PB5578: §2002:13.16.41.3 GR3: a record's size is in bytes whatever its characters (pb1277: a national position is two bytes) and a variable-occurrence table counts at its maximum: FO-N PIC 9 + FO-T OCCURS 1 TO 4 is 5 bytes, so RECORD CONTAINS 5 is accepted and 4 refused COBOL2010 (§2002:13.16.41.2 SR2).
